english.note: Use 消息 as the all-purpose noun for new information or an update about a particular matter.
Use 消息 when the information is news, an update, or something recently learned.
Use this for news or information about what has happened or what someone has been doing.

examples.english: Have you received any news from that company?
examples.traditional: 你有冇收到間公司嗰邊嘅消息？

examples.english: I just got the information that it will rain tomorrow.
